verification.reason: No exact structured USAspending identity isolates NIST, ITA, or BIS AI-safety obligations. The complete FY2025 Commerce account page has 52 rows and no account name containing artificial intelligence, intelligence, AI safety, or AI security. The complete program-activity pages for the closest NIST, BIS, and ITA accounts likewise have no AI-specific row. Assistance Listing autocomplete returns no result for AI safety, machine learning, trustworthy artificial intelligence, or frontier; its one artificial-intelligence result is DOE listing 81.012. The closest NIST award evidence is one FY2025 grant found by free-text description matching under broad listing 11.620. Admitting that keyword result would make an unstable text search the series boundary, while admitting all of 11.620 or a whole NIST account would reverse the required narrow-scoping rule by relabeling a broader total as AI safety.

resultRows.Description: PURPOSE: THE PURPOSE OF THIS PHASE I PROJECT IS TO ADDRESS CRITICAL GAPS IN AI SAFETY AND EXPLAINABILITY. AI ADOPTION IN CRITICAL SECTORS SUCH AS MILITARY AND HEALTHCARE POSES SIGNIFICANT RISKS, AS EXPLOITATION OF THESE SYSTEMS COULD LEAD TO DEVASTATING OUTCOMES. OBJECTSECURITY'S PROPOSED TECHNOLOGY ENHANCES AI CONTENT MODERATION BY EMPLOYING NOVEL LINEAR LAYER CONDUCTANCE TECHNIQUES, INCREASING ANALYSIS EFFICIENCY WITHOUT ADDING SIGNIFICANT COMPUTATIONAL OVERHEAD. THIS METHOD PROVIDES DEEPER INSIGHTS INTO TOKEN RELATIONSHIPS AND PATTERNS INFLUENCING AI OUTPUTS, EMPOWERING DEVELOPERS AND END USERS TO PRECISELY MODERATE AI-GENERATED CONTENT AND PREVENT HARMFUL OUTPUTS.ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED: ANALYSIS AND REQUIREMENTSRESEARCH DEVELOP PROOF OF CONCEPTPRODUCE REPORTSEXPECTED OUTCOMES: BY AUTOMATING COMPLEX ANALYSIS AND ENHANCING MODEL EXPLAINABILITY, OBJECTSECURITY ANTICIPATES THAT ITS PROPOSED TECHNOLOGY WILL ENSURE SAFER AND MORE TRUSTWORTHY AI SYSTEMS. INTENDED BENEFICIARIES INCLUDE: MILITARY AND HEALTHCARE SECTORS.SUBRECIPIENT ACTIVITIES: THE RECIPIENT DOES NOT INTEND TO SUBAWARD FUNDS.
